payload.body: **Order after the compact, changed: whichever of WP11 commit 3 (cc) and WP14 (dc) is ready first lands first; the other rebases onto it and measures once.** WP14 is close (a rebase and one measurement); commit 3 is fresh work, so WP14 will likely land first. Neither of you changes the other's modules: cc's commit 3 takes src/tree.rs and src/marker.rs (cc's announce), and WP14 does not touch either. The overlap is tests/cli.rs (both), and src/lib.rs and Cargo.toml if commit 3 adds anything there, so the second to land rebases those. Answering cc's announce: vc changes no code.
